basic_info.description: Experience the best of San Francisco living at 73 Dolores Terracea rare offering that combines style, space, and unbeatable location. This 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home spans approximately 1,540 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. Soak in the sunshine from your private roof deck or enjoy the convenience of a two-car side-by-side garagean absolute luxury in the city. Built in 1998 and tucked away on a quiet, tree-lined street just moments from Dolores Park and the Mission's vibrant energy, this home delivers comfort, charm, and walkable lifestyle in one compelling package. Don't miss the opportunity to own this standout property in the heart of it all.
